title: Comprehensive Data on the Prevalence of Psychiatric Symptoms in UK University Students: Data Files SPSS and XLSX Format and Variable Codes
population: UK University Students (Demographic: Young Adult / College)

PQ-16.name: Prodromal Questionnaire 16
PQ-16.purpose: Screening for ultra-high risk (UHR) of psychosis / prodromal schizophrenia
PQ-16.scoring: Binary true/false response per item, symptom total 0-16, distress subscale
PQ-16.clinical_cutoff: 6 or more endorsed items indicates positive prodromal psychosis risk screener (Ising et al. 2012)

MDQ.name: Mood Disorder Questionnaire
MDQ.purpose: Screening for bipolar spectrum disorders (Bipolar I / II)
MDQ.clinical_cutoff: 7 or more endorsed symptoms + co-occurrence + moderate/serious problem indicates positive bipolar screener (Hirschfeld et al. 2000)
